lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's six? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 6? Nope!

lines.text: The hour hand points to three. It moves one hour, then two, then three, up to twenty.
lines.caption: The hour hand points to 3. It moves 1 hour, then 2, then 3, up to 20.

lines.text: Where does it point at the end?
lines.caption: Where does it point at the end?

lines.text: Add up the moves in pairs: ten pairs of twenty-one. That's two hundred ten hours.
lines.caption: Add up the moves in pairs: 10 pairs of 21. That's 210 hours.

lines.text: Twelve hours is a full turn. Two hundred ten is seventeen full turns, plus six.
lines.caption: 12 hours is a full turn. 210 is 17 full turns, plus 6.

lines.text: Full turns land right back on three. Only the six leftover hours matter!
lines.caption: Full turns land right back on 3. Only the 6 leftover hours matter!

lines.text: Six more hours from three. The hand lands on nine!
lines.caption: 6 more hours from 3. The hand lands on 9!

lines.text: Six was the trap: it counts from twelve, not from three.
lines.caption: 6 was the trap: it counts from 12, not from 3.

lines.text: Did you get nine? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 9? Tell me below!
